Very soon there will be no reason for retail to need their sales to settle between days. Soon, millions more will have access to margin if they choose to use it. I’m not a scientist but the logic here says retail will now have larger volumes at a higher churn rate. I wonder how that will permanently change market dynamics. In the short term I have a feeling the market will be bullish AF, then when MMs see margin use at all time highs, they attack and crash the market. Margin calls cause sales everywhere, which cascade. Ask last October about it. At least a lot of the brokers made it easy for retail to short as well. Things won’t be the same if you ask me, which no one did. Anyone planning for this?
